questions.question: What is an algorithm?
options: A precise, step-by-step recipe for solving a problem
questions.explanation: Algorithms exist outside code too: directions and recipes are algorithms.

questions.question: Your `largest(numbers)` function works on [3, 9, 2]. What edge case should you also test?
questions.explanation: Edge cases (empty input, one item, duplicates, negatives) are where most bugs hide.
